text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, I wanted to show off 
the grit of youth, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With results like this, it's totally 
choveriba, right? Maruzen's gonna do her 
best!
choice_data_list: If anything, we're on a roll!

choveriba, right? Maruzen's gonna do her 
best!
choice_data_list: If anything, we're on a roll!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're right, panicking won't lead to any 
good results!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's all for today! Let's get 
changed and go grab some Italian food.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, would you like to join me if 
you want?

And so, taking breaks to refresh her mood 
along the way, she adjusted her condition 
and prepared for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list:
Let's break through adversity and surprise 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They even said so in my mom's favorite 
show, "Fiery Passionate Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"The higher the wall, the more you grow 
when you overcome it. Throw yourself 
against it with everything you've got!" 
they said.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright! As soon as we get back, we're 
training! Let's head off into the sunset!

"We promised to celebrate with nata de 
coco juice if we won— and with that 
promise, we tackled the grueling 
training."
